PF1EL.Help.ClassFeatures: Grant these items as children when this item's associated class reaches the listed level.
PF1EL.Help.SpellSupplements: Route these spells into a spellbook. Choose the destination and, optionally, gate each spell behind a class level or Hit Dice total.
PF1EL.PerDayHint: Uses per day for this spell-like ability. 0 = at will.
PF1EL.PoolHint: Spells in one pool share a single daily count.
PF1EL.Grant.Title: Granted by
PF1EL.Mode.Label: Destination
PF1EL.Gating.Label: Level gating
PF1EL.Castable.Label: Require castable level
PF1EL.Castable.Hint: Also hold each spell back until the destination spellbook can cast that spell level. A partial caster then receives a spell later than a full caster does — or never, if its progression never reaches that level.
PF1EL.Domain.Label: Domain/School spells
PF1EL.Domain.Hint: Mark granted spells as Domain/School spells.
PF1EL.Archetype.DropClass: Drop the base class here to choose which features it replaces.
PF1EL.Warning.ClassOnly: Drop a class item here to pick the base class.
PF1EL.Warning.SpellOnly: Only spells can be added to Spell Supplements.
PF1EL.Warning.BadDrop: That item could not be resolved and was not added.
PF1EL.Warning.SourceMissing: That link's source item could not be found.
PF1EL.Setting.Dedupe.Name: Don't duplicate linked items
PF1EL.Setting.Dedupe.Hint: When Supplements or Class Features would add something the actor already has, use the existing item instead of creating a copy. Physical items and spells are always copied.
PF1EL.Warning.NoClassSpell: This item type can't be tied to a class, so Class Spellcasting is unavailable — spells will route to Spell-like Abilities.
